    ATS CheckerGuidesFeaturesAbout

    What the checker does

    A free tool for finding common resume problems before you apply. It gives an estimate based on general checks, not a prediction of how any employer's system will rate you.

    ATS compatibility score

    A score from 0 to 100, based on common issues that can make a resume harder for software and recruiters to read.

    • Overall score
    • Breakdown by category
    • Results in seconds
    • No account needed

    Resume structure checks

    Finds missing sections, dates that are hard to follow, signs of table layouts and unusual characters.

    • Required and optional sections
    • Work history dates
    • Header and footer warnings
    • Special characters

    Writing suggestions

    Points out weak or generic wording and explains why each suggestion matters.

    • Action verbs
    • Measurable results
    • Generic phrases
    • Bullet points and density

    Optional AI analysis

    Ask for an AI review of your resume's content. Use it as a second opinion and check its advice against your own experience.

    • Strengths and weaknesses
    • Possible skill gaps
    • Industries your experience fits
    • Improvement ideas

    Clear data handling

    The basic score runs in your browser. Resume text only leaves your device if you choose the AI analysis.

    • In-browser scoring
    • AI analysis is opt-in
    • No signup
    • Explained in our Privacy Policy

    Practical guides

    Free articles on how applicant tracking systems read resumes, how to format yours and how to tailor it to a job.

    • Resume formatting
    • Bullet point examples
    • Tailoring to a posting
    • Career gaps and first resumes
